campaign: V1 Phase B B.6''.9.1 - F-VLLM-PLUGIN-CRASH bisect diagnostic
purpose: Per Anil B.6''.9.1: identify root-cause of vLLM segfault during model loading under installed cipher-platform v2.0 rev5 .deb. Read-only diagnostic; no substrate code changes.
method: Bisect ownership via CDI patch revert / env-gate matrix. systemd watcher temporarily disabled during CDI revert; restored at end of substep.

bisect_test_matrix.description: vLLM in container WITHOUT any CIPHER (CDI patch reverted; watcher disabled)
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: Baseline confirmed. vLLM v0.21.0 works on this pod without CIPHER. Crash IS caused by something CIPHER adds.

bisect_test_matrix.description: Full CIPHER CDI applied; substrate libs + env in container; VLLM_PLUGINS=none gates plugin entry-points from loading
bisect_test_matrix.result: PASS - substrate constructor fires; WARMUP_OK 34.9s INFERENCE_OK 0.7s tok/s=245.1
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: Substrate (libcipher_rt.so + libc10 + libcipher_v2 + cuInit hook + GOT patcher + dlsym hook + 17 trampolines) IS compatible with vLLM v0.21.0. Crash is in the PLUGIN CHAIN, not substrate.

bisect_test_matrix.description: Substrate + plugin chain loaded; both master-disabled via env gates
bisect_test_matrix.result: PASS - both plugins log 'disabled via CIPHER_KV_*' + vLLM works
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: Plugin chain DISCOVERY works (entry-points load fine); active hooks are what crashes.

bisect_test_matrix.description: Suppress cipher_kv_offload; keep cipher_vllm_kv hooks active
bisect_test_matrix.result: CRASH - KV buffers owned by CIPHER VMM (22 tensors, 88 pages, 0.17 GiB); segfault
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: Crash narrowed to cipher_vllm_kv. cipher_kv_offload is NOT culprit.

bisect_test_matrix.description: Suppress cipher_vllm_kv; keep cipher_kv_offload hooks active
bisect_test_matrix.result: PASS - vLLM works with cipher_kv_offload active
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: Confirms cipher_kv_offload not culprit. cipher_vllm_kv is the suspect.

bisect_test_matrix.description: cipher_vllm_kv VMM allocator + KV ownership hooks active; kmod IOCTL chain suppressed
bisect_test_matrix.result: PASS - VMM allocator works (KV buffers owned 36.14 GiB), vLLM runs through warmup + inference
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: VMM allocator + KV buffer ownership are NOT culprit. Crash is in the kmod IOCTL chain (REGISTER_MODEL or REGISTER_STREAMS).

bisect_test_matrix.result: CRASH - REGISTER_MODEL OK uuid=4b97c8ea13de88947a3e486b073fa1b9; segfault later
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: CRASH IS IN REGISTER_MODEL CODE PATH.

bisect_test_matrix.result: PASS - REGISTER_MODEL gate off, uuid stays MODEL_UNKNOWN; WARMUP+INFERENCE PASS tok/s=248.0
bisect_test_matrix.interpretation: REGISTER_STREAMS is fine. REGISTER_MODEL IS the crash component.

root_cause.component: cipher_vllm_kv plugin's CIPHER_REGISTER_MODEL ioctl (NR 27) downstream code path
root_cause.specific_finding: REGISTER_MODEL ioctl ITSELF returns OK (logged as 'REGISTER_MODEL OK: arch=3 uuid=4b97c8ea13de88947a3e486b073fa1b9 path=...'); crash happens AFTER, in code that uses the returned model_uuid.
root_cause.downstream_path_under_suspicion: Likely paths that read model_uuid after REGISTER_MODEL returns: per-tenant per-token AUDIT hook on execute_model, or KV-cache tensor metadata tagging with uuid, or any plugin/substrate code that branches on model_uuid != MODEL_UNKNOWN.
root_cause.memory_29_g10_abi_context: Per memory g10-abi-scaffold: CIPHER_REGISTER_MODEL ioctl NR 27 + model_registry shipped at W7-9 Step 1; test_register_model 5/5 PASS at that era. v0.21.0 vLLM is significantly newer than W7-9 vLLM context; some downstream code path that uses model_uuid is incompatible with v0.21.0 internals.

remediation_options_for_anil_pick.description: Inject CIPHER_REGISTER_MODEL=0 via CIPHER CDI env. Plugin loads but G10 ioctl is gated off; model_uuid stays MODEL_UNKNOWN; downstream crash never triggers.
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.effort: ~0.1 ED (cipher_cdi_patch.py CIPHER_ENV extension + test case + .deb rebuild)
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.trade: Goal 1 (multi-tenant per-model routing) capability degraded — model_uuid is the per-tenant model fingerprint used for cross-tenant weight sharing inferred at routing time. Without REGISTER_MODEL, substrate cannot distinguish 'tenant A using Mistral-7B' from 'tenant B using Llama-3-8B' beyond what stream-resolver provides. Track 2 weight-sharing (Memory #28 76% baseline) DOES NOT depend on REGISTER_MODEL (it uses the kmod weight arena directly via sc5_arena_ioctl), so the SC6 result holds. Goal 4 (Koopman) doesn't depend on model_uuid. Real impact: substrate-level model identification is degraded; observability + per-model actuator-routing in v2 architecture is delayed
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.honest_residue: v1 ships with model_uuid=MODEL_UNKNOWN; v1.x or v2 fixes the downstream path

remediation_options_for_anil_pick.description: Inspect cipher_vllm_kv source for code paths that branch on model_uuid; identify which path crashes under vLLM v0.21.0; fix the crash trigger source-side
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.effort: ~1-3 ED depending on root cause (could be a few lines or a structural refactor)
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.trade: Goal 1 capability preserved fully; fix is structurally clean for v1
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.risk: May discover additional v0.21.0-specific incompatibilities once the first one is fixed (kvdedup hook, model_fingerprint tag, AUDIT chain per-tenant routing)

remediation_options_for_anil_pick.description: Ship .deb without cipher_vllm_kv plugin file; ship only cipher_kv_offload + cipher_vllm_kvdedup + substrate. Substrate visibility + KV-offload still work; CIPHER's KV ownership + REGISTER_MODEL path disabled
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.effort: ~0.25 ED (PLUGIN_MANIFEST.md update + cipher_cdi_patch.py mount list update + .deb rebuild)
remediation_options_for_anil_pick.trade: Loses both Goal 1 model fingerprinting AND the cipher_vllm_kv KV ownership hook (VMM allocator); cipher-vllm-kvdedup also depends on cipher_vllm_kv VMM allocator so it would also need to be disabled. Substantial v1 scope-down.

recommendation: Option A (env-gate REGISTER_MODEL=0 via CDI) for v1 fast path; v1.x picks up Option B with source-level fix. Track 2 weight-sharing (76% baseline) preserved; substrate visibility (cublasGemmEx + Path B' + dlsym hook + 17 trampolines) preserved; KV-cache buffer ownership (Option A KV path) preserved. Only model_uuid-tagged paths are downgraded to MODEL_UNKNOWN.
implications_for_b6_9_4_measurement: Once Option A lands at B.6''.9.3, B.6''.9.4 re-measurement can proceed: substrate sees vLLM workload via the cipher_vllm_kv VMM allocator + KV buffer ownership + Step 4 per-token AUDIT hook on execute_model (which fires regardless of REGISTER_MODEL state per cipher_vllm_kv.py source). The H2 graph-replay blind spot still applies (substrate's CUPTI doesn't observe graph replay); B.6''.9.8 driver-API substrate is still needed for that gap.
